scope: 미니멀 게임 UI: 기본·건설·시설 선택의 세 상태
approach: 상시 자원 3개와 시간·메뉴·주 행동 3개. 작업창은 한 번에 하나만 연다.
defaultPrompt:
Edit the supplied TownGrid game screenshot into a radically simplified, beautifully restrained MINIMAL GAMEPLAY UI concept. This is the default idle PLAYING state of a pixel-art town-builder. Preserve the existing actual pixel village: same modest orange timber saw workshop, blue-roof warehouse, well, three red-roof cottages, road, horse cart, river, forest, camera angle and building locations. Remove EVERY piece of the old UI and fill newly exposed areas with consistent continuous map terrain. Remove the old white connection line and selection brackets too. Pixel art gameplay map must occupy about 94% of the visible screen. Keep this exact 16:9 landscape composition, full bleed, no border or browser. Do not change this into an illustration, website, idle-game dashboard, or new architectural art style.

Then add ONLY the following THREE SMALL interface groups at the screen EDGES. Be strict: very few controls and very little total UI area.
1. TOP LEFT, 20px from edges, one plain matte dark-teal strip, approximately 335px wide by 42px tall on this 1672px wide screenshot. No decorative frame. It holds three simple readable pixel resource icons and numbers in ONE LINE: gold coin '2,500', log '52', stone '30'. NO boxes or dividing borders around individual resources. Cream text, clear sans-serif. A tiny downward caret at end means expand all resources. No region header, no game logo, no name plaque.
2. TOP RIGHT, 20px from edges, one very small plain control cluster approximately 200px wide by 40px tall: '1일째', pause icon, '1×', three-horizontal-lines menu icon. Uniform dark-teal backing with comfortable but compact spacing. No borders between controls. No separate 2×/4×, no help, speaker, portrait, resident count, notification panel, quest panel or settings row. Other speeds open from 1×.
3. BOTTOM CENTER, 22px above bottom, one small low matte dark-teal action dock approximately 350px wide by 48px tall. Three actions only, labeled '시장', '건설', '세계', each with a small simple icon. Only '건설' has a FLAT ORANGE rectangular background with dark text; the others are cream text/icons on the shared teal background. Orange is the only loud accent. Corners at most 3px. Only a fine 1px edge or very subtle single shadow; no big bevel, no double outlines, no mechanical casing.
This is the ENTIRE UI. Exactly those 3 small groups, everything else is open map. No sidebars, no camera buttons, no tool rails, no expanded building catalog, no building cards, no facility inspector, no floating tooltips, no quest/delivery boxes, no stock recipe, no giant frame, no example-state inset, no title or option number stamped on screen. Do NOT scatter tiny unreadable icons to fake minimalism. Use fewer meaningful controls at usable sizes, restrained spacing, simple legible Korean labels.

VISUAL DIRECTION: distilled industrial controls color identity, NOT its ornate material treatment. Dark teal #193f42, ivory #f1eddf, orange #ee701b, simple crisp rectangles. NO RIVETS. NO METAL TEXTURE. NO SHINY BEVELS. NO HEAVY OUTLINES. NO GLASS BLUR. The game world should immediately be the hero and look dramatically calmer than the supplied overloaded screenshot. Keep village artwork legible pixel art; do not fade it into empty whiteness or blur it. UI font clean sans Korean, not pixel lettering. Render the requested full screen final mockup only.
